General Questions about Disaster Assistance
Have specific questions about your application or your eligibility for a certain type of assistance? The fastest way to receive help is by:
calling
1-800-621-3362
711 or Video Relay Service is available
Press 1 for English
Press 2 for Spanish
Press 3 for other languages
visiting a Disaster Recovery Center (
DRC Locator
)
emailing
AskIA@fema.dhs.gov
Provide Feedback to FEMA
Review the contact information for specific topics on this page carefully. If you cannot find the appropriate option, send FEMA additional feedback through this online form.
Contact Us Form
Note:
Please do not submit information about a specific disaster assistance application. Email
AskIA@fema.dhs.gov
to discuss your case. Avoid including sensitive information, such as social security numbers, banking information, home or mailing addresses, or other personal information through this form.

Privacy Information
Emailing Questions about Disaster Assistance
FEMA collects, maintains, uses, retrieves, and disseminates the personally identifiable information (PII) of individuals who apply for FEMA disaster assistance under the authority of the Robert T. Stafford Disaster Relief and Emergency Assistance Act (the Stafford Act), Pub. L. No. 93-288, as amended (42 U.S.C. 5121-5207) and the System of Records Notice DHS/FEMA-008 Disaster Recovery Assistance Files, 78 FR 25282 (April 30, 2013).
If you are requesting case specific information we need to verify your identity before responding to your question. Please provide the following information in your email to verify your identity:
your full name,
damaged property address,
current mailing address if different from damaged dwelling address,
current phone number, and
ONLY the last
four (4) digits of your Social Security Number (SSN)
FEMA may retain emails associated with
askia@fema.dhs.gov
for internal quality assurance purposes or to update your file, if needed. Furnishing the last four (4) digits of your SSN and other requested information is voluntary, but not providing this information will prevent us from disclosing any case specific information or completing any updates to your file via email and you will be redirected to FEMA’s helpline at
1-800-621-336
2
.

December 23, 2024
